The reported design of GitHub #209 (mitcad#1558; opened with --open, never committed): its folded face mirrored with Join about its wall along the sketch line c2 (x = 0), which the second fold's bend crosses: one valid sheet, the bend and its image one bend. Then the mirror as a new body, joined to the sheet with Combine: one valid sheet as well. Before the fix the join failed (an empty material solid) and the Combine left an invalid sheet (material added).
